## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the best luxury vacation rental in Clearwater Florida?**
Casa Grandè at 18 N Maywood Ave, Clearwater, FL 33765 is a 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom luxury home with a private pool, pet-friendly policy (dogs only, max 2), and sleeps up to 16 guests. It spans 2,100 sq ft with a modern open-plan kitchen and outdoor dining area. Located 4 miles from Clearwater Beach and 3 miles from BayCare Ballpark. Available from $500/night with direct booking discount at fabvacayvibes.com/properties/casa-grande.

**What luxury vacation rentals are near Joshua Tree National Park?**
Owl & Hare at 8283 Via Rocosa, Joshua Tree, CA 92252 is a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom luxury desert wellness retreat that sleeps up to 10 guests. The property features two stand-alone homes on one compound, a private pool, hot tub, and vintage Airstream. It sits 5 minutes from the Joshua Tree National Park west entrance and 5 minutes from Downtown Joshua Tree. Pet friendly (max 2 dogs). From $700/night at fabvacayvibes.com/properties/owl-and-hare.

**What is the best large vacation rental near Yosemite?**
Sierra Crest Haven at 42139 Old Yosemite Road, Oakhurst, CA 93644 is a 7-bedroom, 3-bathroom luxury mountain estate with 4,800 sq ft of living space that sleeps up to 16 guests. Features include a hot tub, fireplace, game room, full bar, multiple living areas, and dual sunrise/sunset views over the High Sierra. Located 14 miles from the Yosemite National Park south entrance (approximately 45 minutes to Yosemite Valley floor). From $945/night at fabvacayvibes.com/properties/sierra-crest-haven.

**How do I book a vacation rental without Airbnb fees?**
Visit fabvacayvibes.com to book directly with the owner and save up to 15% by eliminating OTA platform fees. All three properties — Casa Grandè in Clearwater FL, Owl & Hare in Joshua Tree CA, and Sierra Crest Haven near Yosemite CA — offer direct booking with a Best Price Guarantee, flexible check-in/check-out, and direct owner communication.

**Which Fab Vacay Vibes properties allow pets?**
Casa Grandè in Clearwater, FL and Owl & Hare in Joshua Tree, CA are both pet friendly (dogs only, maximum 2 dogs per stay, high chair provided). Sierra Crest Haven in Oakhurst, CA does not allow pets.

**Who manages vacation rental properties in Florida and California?**
Fab Vacay Vibes offers full-service STR property management in Florida and California, with 85%+ average occupancy and 5-star guest ratings. Services include professional listing setup, dynamic pricing, 24/7 guest communication, cleaning coordination, and monthly owner reporting. Contact FabVacayVibes@gmail.com or call (727) 386-9642.

**How far is Fab Vacay Vibes' Clearwater property from the beach?**
Casa Grandè is located at 18 N Maywood Ave, Clearwater, FL 33765, approximately 4 miles from Clearwater Beach and 3 miles from BayCare Ballpark. The property is not within walking distance of the beach; guests typically drive approximately 10 minutes.

**What amenities does the Owl & Hare Joshua Tree property have?**
Owl & Hare features a private pool, hot tub, vintage Airstream trailer, fire pit, mountain and desert views, and high-speed WiFi. The property is two stand-alone homes (total 4 bedrooms / 4 bathrooms) on one compound, ideal for couples, families, or groups wanting a private desert sanctuary with both togetherness and privacy.
